title: FBI-UAP-D024, FD-302, “Airborne Lights and Triangle,” 2002, 2023-2024
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-302 interview report regarding pilot observations of aerial phenomena, containing one specific encounter report of a triangle-shaped object.

encounters.summary: A pilot observed a large, silent, equilateral triangle-shaped object blocking out stars while stationed in Bagram, Afghanistan.
encounters.entity_appearance: equilateral triangle shape, estimated 500 feet in size
encounters.entity_behavior: moving silently at a consistent speed and altitude
encounters.quote: It appeared as if something huge went overhead, from west to east, and was an equilateral triangle shape.
